title: Gaussian law of a linear combination
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $b,c\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $0\le c$ and $b^2+c^2=1$. If $X,Y$ are independent standard Gaussian vectors in $\mathbb R^n$, then $bX+cY$ has the standard Gaussian product law on $\mathbb R^n$.
